definition: The rate of chemical or biochemical reactions and the specific mechanisms governing ligand-receptor association and dissociation.
etymology: From Ancient Greek κινητικός (kinētikós, 'moving, put in motion').
manuscriptExample: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assays established rapid association kinetics alongside an exceptionally slow off-rate.
conferenceExample: Reviewer 2 queried whether temperature shifts altered enzymatic cleavage kinetics in cell-free systems.

definition: An experimental technique that transiently reduces gene expression without complete genetic deletion.
manuscriptExample: siRNA-mediated knockdown of GAPDH reduced transcript levels by 85% compared to non-targeting controls.
conferenceExample: We performed Western blot verification 48 hours post-transfection to confirm sustained protein knockdown.
